Founder project

Funnel Aether.

An AI-human hybrid marketing platform for micro and small businesses — the ones enterprise software priced out and spreadsheets never really served. In development in Leeds, built for Leeds and Lagos.

Talk to me about it
Concept & prototypeUK first, Nigeria second0–49 employee businesses

The problem

Small businesses have marketing tools. They don't have marketing.

A micro business in Leeds runs its email in Mailchimp, its customers in a basic CRM and its social from a phone. A retailer in Lagos runs the whole operation through WhatsApp Business and a notebook. Neither has a marketing problem exactly — they have a joining-up problem. The data never meets, so nobody can tell what's working.

Enterprise platforms solve this, at enterprise prices and enterprise complexity. Funnel Aether is built for the 0–49 employee businesses those platforms were never designed for.

The approach

AI does the volume.
A human still decides.

Most AI marketing tools ask you to trust the output. Funnel Aether doesn't — every piece of content passes through a human review queue before it goes anywhere, on every tier including the free one.

PHASE 01

Attract

AI drafts content and SEO briefs. The human approves voice and verifies claims.

PHASE 02

Convert

AI scores leads and optimises forms. The human sets the offer and qualification rules.

PHASE 03

Engage

AI sequences and schedules sends. The human sets frequency and tone.

PHASE 04

Analyse

AI flags patterns and anomalies. The human interprets what they mean.

PHASE 05

Optimise

AI proposes experiments. The human approves the trade-offs and the budget.

Brand voice

Trained on your words, not the internet's.

Rather than fine-tuning a model, Funnel Aether builds a Brand Knowledge Base from your own approved material — five to fifteen examples plus your compliance rules — and retrieves from it at the moment of writing. Every draft arrives with a brand-voice confidence score and any compliance flags attached, so the reviewer knows where to look.

Status

Concept and early prototype.

Funnel Aether began as part of my MSc at Leeds Trinity University and remains in active development, with Leeds as the first validation market and Lagos as the second. It isn't open for sign-ups yet.

If you run a small business and this sounds like your problem, I'd genuinely like to talk to you — early conversations with real operators are worth more than another month of planning. Get in touch.
